hypothesis: A deterministic, metadata-only DocumentCloud resolver turns concrete public DocumentCloud canonical URLs and public PDF/file URLs into VerifiedArtifact document records, while rejecting protected/login/non-public links and never downloading.
change_summary: Added pipeline2_discovery/casegraph/resolvers/documentcloud_files.py with DocumentCloudFileResolution dataclass and resolve_documentcloud_files(packet) function. Identifies DocumentCloud sources by api_name=='documentcloud' OR source_authority=='documentcloud' OR source_type=='documentcloud_document' OR url on documentcloud.org domain (or canonical_url/pdf_url metadata pointing there). Pulls candidates from metadata.pdf_url, metadata.canonical_url, metadata.file_url, metadata.download_url, metadata.links[], and source.url. Rejects: any URL with login/signin/private/protected/auth/token markers; any source whose metadata.access is private/organization/pending/draft/invisible. Accepted public URLs become VerifiedArtifacts: format=pdf if .pdf extension, format=document for documentcloud.org canonical pages, format=html for other public pages. artifact_type defaults to 'docket_docs' (DocumentCloud is documents-only — never video/audio). source_authority='documentcloud'. Verification methods: documentcloud_pdf_url / documentcloud_canonical_url / documentcloud_metadata. Preserves documentcloud_id, publisher, published_date, page_count, language. Dedupes against packet.verified_artifacts by URL. Re-exported from resolvers/__init__.py and casegraph/__init__.py. Tests: tests/test_casegraph_documentcloud_file_resolver.py with 10 deterministic tests (all passing).
notes: Document-only CasePacket through full pipeline (resolve_identity + resolve_outcome + extract_artifact_claims + resolve_documentcloud_files + score_case_packet) verified to remain HOLD with reason_codes including 'document_only_hold' and risk_flags including 'no_verified_media' — confirms invariant. NO downloads, NO scraping, NO OCR. NO live APIs called. Resolver shares the metadata/protected-marker discipline of muckrock_files.py without reusing its private helpers (kept independent for clarity).

hypothesis: Public CourtListener opinion URLs and public RECAP per-document URLs become document VerifiedArtifacts; PACER URLs and bare docket landing pages are rejected; the resolver never downloads, never scrapes, never follows paywalled access.
change_summary: Added pipeline2_discovery/casegraph/resolvers/courtlistener_documents.py with CourtListenerDocumentResolution dataclass and resolve_courtlistener_documents(packet) function. Identifies CourtListener sources by api_name=='courtlistener' OR source_authority=='court' with court_opinion/court_docket/court_search_result type OR url on courtlistener.com. Pulls candidates from source.url, metadata.absolute_url, metadata.download_url, metadata.filepath_ia, metadata.filepath_local, metadata.pdf_url, and nested metadata.recap_documents[].{absolute_url, download_url, filepath_ia, filepath_local, pdf_url} (also documents[]/items[] aliases). Acceptance rules: courtlistener.com URLs accepted only on /opinion/ or /recap-document/ or /document/ paths (NOT bare /docket/<id>/<slug>/ landing pages — that emits a 'find a public opinion or RECAP URL' next_action); external URLs accepted only with .pdf/.doc/.docx/.rtf/.txt extension AND not on a PACER host (ecf.uscourts.gov, pacer.uscourts.gov, pcl.uscourts.gov, or any *.uscourts.gov path containing /cgi-bin/ or /pacer/) AND not protected. PACER detection emits 'pacer_or_paywalled' risk flag. login/auth/token markers emit 'protected_or_nonpublic' risk flag. VerifiedArtifact: format=pdf for .pdf URLs, format=document for courtlistener.com pages, format=html otherwise; artifact_type='docket_docs' (CourtListener never produces media/audio); source_authority='court'; verification_method = courtlistener_opinion / courtlistener_recap_document / courtlistener_metadata / external_public_pdf. Preserves court, docket_number, case_name, date_filed, date_terminated, search_type. Dedupes against packet.verified_artifacts by URL. Re-exported from resolvers/__init__.py and casegraph/__init__.py. Tests: tests/test_casegraph_courtlistener_document_resolver.py with 11 deterministic tests (all passing).
notes: Document-only CourtListener packet through full pipeline (resolve_identity + resolve_outcome + extract_artifact_claims + resolve_courtlistener_documents + score_case_packet) verified to remain HOLD with reason_codes including 'document_only_hold' and risk_flags including 'no_verified_media' — confirms invariant. Bare /docket/<id>/<slug>/ landing page is NOT treated as an artifact (a bare docket is just metadata, not a verifiable document). NO downloads, NO scraping, NO PACER calls, NO live APIs.

Real-live path: fires a single capped DocumentCloud HTTPS call, runs resolve_documentcloud_files, assembles a CasePacket from the MPV row + live SourceRecords, scores it, and writes 9 canonical deliverables to autoresearch/.runs/live6/ (gitignored): live_bundle.json, dry_bundle_for_comparison.json, comparison.json, ledger_entry.json, live_yield.json, scoreboard.json, endpoint_v0_status.json, pilot3_selection.json, dry_bundle.json.
notes: First authorized real-live Endpoint v0 attempt. ONE capped HTTPS call to DocumentCloud (api.www.documentcloud.org), HTTP 200, 5 public canonical URLs returned in 2.63s, all 5 graduated to document VerifiedArtifacts (artifact_type=docket_docs, format=pdf / document, source_authority=documentcloud, confidence ~0.85). Verdict stayed SKIP per the deterministic scorer because the MPV row alone produces low identity_confidence and unknown outcome -- the media gate is non-negotiable and document-only output cannot PRODUCE. ZERO Brave / Firecrawl / LLM / download / scraping / transcript-fetching calls. Endpoint v0 framework is OPERATIONAL: all 8 tracked sub-conditions in endpoint_v0_status.json are True. Two CONDITION 3 sub-bullets cannot be evaluated against the current MPV placeholder fixture: 'identity locked high' and 'concluded outcome' depend on the seed fixture being a real case with a verifiable defendant + outcome. Recommendation in next batch: add a real-case fixture to pilot_manifest.json so the live pipeline can be exercised against a case where identity / outcome actually lock.
